build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs using gtn
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a given number of output classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph for features and classes in a CRF
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF negative log-likelihood loss for a sequence pair using forward score
